title: handle_block ignores activity object, blocks by actor only
description: inbox.rs:1444-1457. The handle_block function ignores _activity entirely and removes all followers/follows/requests for the remote actor across ALL local accounts. The Block activity's 'object' field identifies WHICH local account is being blocked, but this is never examined. If a remote user blocks persona A, persona B also loses their follower/follow relationship with that remote user.
